configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl
configurePresets.description: Release build pinned to clang-cl — the only Windows toolchain that both reaches AVX-512 and keeps the MSVC ABI. Run from a Developer Command Prompt (or after vcvars64.bat) so clang-cl, rc.exe, INCLUDE and LIB are present. Pins C as well as C++, because Highway enables both languages and leaving C to default hands MSVC-style flags to a GNU-driver clang. Pins the generator too, unlike every other preset here, and must: under the Visual Studio generator CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER is ignored outright (clang-cl is chosen there by toolset, -T ClangCL) and CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE is ignored as well, that generator being multi-config and Debug by default — so without Ninja this preset silently delivers an MSVC Debug build under a name promising clang-cl Release. Verified, not theorised.
